steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.env.weather.cloud=0.25; g.env.weather.cloudTarget=0.25; g.env.weather.rain=0; g.env.weather.rainTarget=0; g.env.weather.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); g.hud.show(false); __rhf.god(true); g.env.setTime(11); g.env.timeScale=0; window.__look=async(tx,ty,tz,dist,label,opts={})=>{ const W=g.world; const C=g.colliders; let best=null; for(let k=0;k<36;k++){ const a=k/36*Math.PI*2; for(const dd of [dist, dist*0.7, dist*1.3]){ const x=tx+Math.cos(a)*dd, z=tz+Math.sin(a)*dd; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,10)) continue; const wat=W.waterAt(x,z); if(wat && wat.depth>0.2) continue; if(C.circlesNear(x,z,1.2).length) continue; const eye=W.heightAt(x,z)+1.7; let clear=true; for(let i=1;i<14;i++){ const t=i/14; const px=x+(tx-x)*t, pz=z+(tz-z)*t; const ly=eye+(ty+0.6-eye)*t; if(W.heightAt(px,pz)>ly-0.35){ clear=false; break; } } if(!clear) continue; let trees=0; for(let i=1;i<10;i++){ const t=i/10; trees+=C.circlesNear(x+(tx-x)*t, z+(tz-z)*t, 0.9).length; } const score=trees*10+Math.abs(dd-dist); if(!best||score<best.score) best={x,z,h:W.heightAt(x,z),score}; } } if(!best) return label+': no spot'; g.player.place(best.x,best.z,Math.atan2(-(tx-best.x),-(tz-best.z))); const P=g.player.pos; g.player.pitch=Math.atan2(ty+0.4-(best.h+1.7),Math.hypot(tx-best.x,tz-best.z)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,opts.wait||3500)); g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(tx-P.x),-(tz-P.z)); return label+' score '+best.score.toFixed(1); }; window.__animal=(sp)=>g.wildlife.animals.find(a=>a.species===sp); window.__bird=(sp)=>g.wildlife.birds.find(b=>b.sp===sp); for(const a of g.wildlife.animals) a.cfg.flee=0; return 'ok'})()
(async()=>{const a=__animal('goat'); for(const o of __rhf.game.wildlife.animals) if(o.species==='goat') o.cfg.flee=0; return __look(a.x,a.y,a.z,22,'goat')})()
(async()=>{const w=__rhf.game.wildlife; if(!w.haulOut) return 'no haul-out'; const h=w.haulOut; return __look(h.x,1,h.z,45,'sealion')})()
(async()=>{const w=__rhf.game.wildlife; const b=w.beavers[0]; if(!b) return 'no beaver'; b.under=0; return __look(b.lodge.x,b.lake.level,b.lodge.z,30,'beaver lodge')})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const w=g.wildlife; const pod=w.orcaPod; const p=g.world.place('pier'); pod.x=p.x-g.world.place('pier').dock.x0+p.x; pod.z=p.z; const d=p.dock; const gx=d.x1-d.x0, gz=d.z1-d.z0; const l=Math.hypot(gx,gz); pod.x=d.x1+gx/l*70; pod.z=d.z1+gz/l*70; pod.yaw=Math.atan2(gz,gx); for(const o of w.orcas) o.t=1.0; g.player.place(p.x,p.z,Math.atan2(-(pod.x-p.x),-(pod.z-p.z))); g.player.pitch=-0.05; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); return 'orcas'})()
